items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

ctx.x: And the second thing is he wants a very obscure Dizzy Gillespie record because he set some lyrics to “Scheherazade.” That theme [humms] I can’t sing it right now because I was thinking of something else and I don’t sing well. And Dizzy is on a pop record where somebody had set lyrics to it a zillion years ago with an organist and playing odd figures behind it. And apparently Jon’s got a gig and a record coming up so he needs to hear that. So I’m going to get that to him and the rhythm section thing. And that’s…
